{{Short description|Black brane solution in eleven-dimensional supergravity}}
{{string theory}}

In [[theoretical physics]], an '''M5-brane''' is a fundamental [[brane]] of [[M-theory]]. As such, it can be described explicitly as a black brane solution<ref>{{cite journal |last=Gueven |first=Rahmi |year=1992 |title=Black p-brane solutions of D = 11 supergravity theory |journal=Physics Letters B  |volume=276 |issue=49 |doi=10.1016/0370-2693(92)90540-K |pages=49–55}}</ref> to [[eleven-dimensional supergravity]], the low-energy limit of M-theory. In particular, it carries a [[magnetic charge]] under the 3-form gauge field of the 11-dimensional [[supermultiplet|supergravity multiplet]]. The M5-brane is the [[Montonen–Olive duality|electric-magnetic dual]] of the [[M2-brane]].

Upon [[compactification (physics)|compactification]], the M5-brane becomes either the [[D4-brane]] or the [[NS5-brane]] of [[type IIA supergravity]], depending on whether the 11-dimensional theory is reduced along a direction parallel or orthogonal to the M5-brane, respectively.

The worldvolume theory on a stack of M5-branes at low energies is the [[6D (2,0) superconformal field theory|six-dimensional N=(2,0) superconformal field theory]] (SCFT) with [[gauge group|gauge algebra]] of the [[ADE classification|A-type]].<ref>{{cite journal |last=Witten |first=Edward |year=1997 |title=Five-brane effective action in M-theory |journal=Journal of Geometry and Physics  |volume=22 |issue=2 |pages=103–133|doi=10.1016/S0393-0440(97)80160-X|arxiv=hep-th/9610234 }}</ref> Other gauge algebras can be realised by placing the stack of branes on a singularity.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Ferrara |first1=Sergio |last2=Kehagias |first2=Alexandros |last3=Partouche |first3=Hervé |last4=Zaffaroni |first4=Alberto |year=1998 |title=Membranes and Fivebranes with Lower Supersymmetry and their AdS Supergravity Duals  |journal=Physics Letters B  |volume=431 |pages=42–48|doi=10.1016/S0370-2693(98)00558-9|arxiv=hep-th/9803109 }}</ref>

The PST model provides a Green-Schwarz description of the worldvolume physics of a single M5-brane.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Pasti |first1=Paolo |last2=Sorokin |first2=Dmitri |last3=Tonin |first3=Mario |year=1997 |title=Covariant Action for a D = 11 Five-Brane with the Chiral Field  |journal=Physics Letters B  |volume=398 |pages=41|doi=10.1016/S0370-2693(97)00188-3|arxiv=hep-th/9701037 }}</ref> On the other hand, direct knowledge of the non-Abelian case, for instance via a [[Lagrangian mechanics|Lagrangian]] description, is not presently available, due to various technical difficulties. Since superconformal symmetry is only available in 6 or lower spacetime dimensions, this maximally [[supersymmetry|supersymmetric]] theory may be used to derive an infinite number of other theories. Furthermore, via the [[AdS/CFT correspondence]], the M5-brane worldvolume theory can be used to study [[M-theory]] on asymptotically [[Anti-de Sitter space|Anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetimes]].

Despite the lack of a Lagrangian formulation, brane constructions provide evidence that the M5-brane worldvolume theory can support four- and two-codimensional solitonic excitations, namely self-dual strings and three-branes.
